title: Arazzo Proof Runner
user: An API owner experimenting with OpenAPI Arazzo who needs a small local runner that turns a multi-step workflow into a reproducible evidence report for tests and integration reviews.
smallest_useful_product: CLI supports a documented Arazzo subset, executes against a selected environment, captures redacted request/response metadata and assertions, compares two runs, and writes a static HTML/JSON proof bundle.
success_measure: Runs three representative multi-step Arazzo workflows deterministically in CI and makes a changed response assertion visible in a one-file report.
constraints: Never serialize authorization values; require an explicit environment file; track the evolving Arazzo specification and clearly label unsupported features.
